description: This file defines data structures and enums used for serialization and schema management in PyTorch's export serialization process, including schema versioning, tensor metadata, symbolic expressions, and graph representations.

classes.name: ScalarType
classes.description: Enumeration of scalar data types used in tensor serialization.

classes.name: Layout
classes.description: Enumeration of tensor layout types.

classes.name: MemoryFormat
classes.description: Enumeration of memory formats for tensors.

classes.name: Device
classes.description: Represents a device with type and optional index.

classes.name: SymExprHint
classes.description: Union type for symbolic expression hints (int, bool, float).

classes.name: SymExpr
classes.description: Stores symbolic expressions with optional hints.

classes.name: SymInt
classes.description: Union of symbolic integer or concrete int.

classes.name: SymFloat
classes.description: Union of symbolic float or concrete float.

classes.name: SymBool
classes.description: Union of symbolic bool or concrete bool.

classes.name: TensorMeta
classes.description: Metadata for tensors including dtype, shape, device, layout, etc.

classes.name: SymIntArgument
classes.description: Argument type for symbolic integers, with name or int value.

classes.name: SymFloatArgument
classes.description: Argument type for symbolic floats, with name or float value.

classes.name: SymBoolArgument
classes.description: Argument type for symbolic bools, with name or bool value.

classes.name: TensorArgument
classes.description: Represents a tensor argument with a name.

classes.name: TokenArgument
classes.description: Represents a token argument with a name.

classes.name: OptionalTensorArgument
classes.description: Union type for optional tensors, with tensor or None.

classes.name: GraphArgument
classes.description: Graph argument with name and nested graph.

classes.name: CustomObjArgument
classes.description: Custom object argument with class FQN.

classes.name: ComplexValue
classes.description: Represents a complex number with real and imaginary parts.

classes.name: Argument
classes.description: Union type for various argument kinds used in graphs and nodes.

classes.name: ArgumentKind
classes.description: Enum for argument positional or keyword.

classes.name: NamedArgument
classes.description: Named argument with name, argument value, and optional kind.

classes.name: Node
classes.description: Represents a computation node in a graph with target, inputs, outputs, and metadata.

classes.name: Graph
classes.description: Graph structure with inputs, outputs, nodes, and associated metadata.

classes.name: UserInputSpec
classes.description: Specification for user input arguments.

classes.name: ConstantValue
classes.description: Union of constant value types.

classes.name: InputToConstantInputSpec
classes.description: Mapping from input name to constant value.

classes.name: InputToParameterSpec
classes.description: Mapping from input to parameter name.

classes.name: InputToBufferSpec
classes.description: Mapping from input to buffer name with persistence flag.

classes.name: InputToTensorConstantSpec
classes.description: Mapping from input to tensor constant name.

classes.name: InputToCustomObjSpec
classes.description: Mapping from input to custom object name.

classes.name: InputTokenSpec
classes.description: Input specification for tokens.

classes.name: InputSpec
classes.description: Union of various input specifications.

classes.name: UserOutputSpec
classes.description: Specification for user output arguments.

classes.name: LossOutputSpec
classes.description: Specification for loss output.

classes.name: BufferMutationSpec
classes.description: Spec for mutating buffers.

classes.name: ParameterMutationSpec
classes.description: Spec for mutating parameters.

classes.name: GradientToParameterSpec
classes.description: Spec for gradient to parameter mapping.

classes.name: GradientToUserInputSpec
classes.description: Spec for gradient to user input mapping.

classes.name: UserInputMutationSpec
classes.description: Spec for mutating user inputs.

classes.name: OutputTokenSpec
classes.description: Spec for output tokens.

classes.name: OutputSpec
classes.description: Union of various output specifications.

classes.name: GraphSignature
classes.description: Signature of a graph with input and output specs.

classes.name: RangeConstraint
classes.description: Constraints on value ranges.

classes.name: ModuleCallSignature
classes.description: Signature for module calls, including input/output args and specs.

classes.name: ModuleCallEntry
classes.description: Entry for a module call with FQN and signature.

classes.name: NamedTupleDef
classes.description: Definition of namedtuple fields.

classes.name: GraphModule
classes.description: Graph module with nested graph, signature, call graph, and metadata.

classes.name: SchemaVersion
classes.description: Schema version with major and minor numbers.

classes.name: ExportedProgram
classes.description: Complete exported program including graph module, version info, and metadata.

classes.name: PayloadMeta
classes.description: Metadata for payloads in PT2 archive.

classes.name: PayloadConfig
classes.description: Mapping from payload FQN to its metadata.

classes.name: AOTInductorModelPickleData
classes.description: Data structure for serializing AOTInductor models.

classes.name: ExternKernelNode
classes.description: Representation of an external kernel node.

classes.name: ExternKernelNodes
classes.description: Collection of external kernel nodes.
